name: Gradient
description: Fills the frame with a smooth blend between two colours, from top to bottom or from left to right.

params.label: Start colour
params.description: The colour at the top (or at the left), as footage carries it: sRGB values from 0 to 1, and alpha.

params.label: End colour
params.description: The colour at the bottom (or at the right), as footage carries it: sRGB values from 0 to 1, and alpha.

params.label: Left to right
params.description: On: the colours blend from left to right. Off: from top to bottom.

author: Example Author
